messages:
mia: Quick copy pass for the "Apply quantization" modal. Need clear, non-scary wording and a short required confirmation for high-risk profiles. Draft below.

mia: Draft: `Apply quantization to {{model_name}}? This can lower cost and latency. You may notice minor quality differences. Apply quantization · Cancel`

ben: Tone good. For high-risk profiles add a checkbox: `I understand this may change output quality and metrics.` and disable Apply until checked.

hao: Engineering: include risk level in payload: `quant.risk=low|high`. Tooltip on Apply: `Creates rollback snapshot; reverting may require redeploy.` Keep tooltip <100 chars.

a11y-bot: Accessibility: modal role=dialog, aria-labelledby for title, checkbox must have clear label, focus trap, and tooltip accessible via keyboard (aria-describedby). If checkbox required, announce that to screen readers.

mia: Final copy for PR (mild risk): `Apply quantization profile to {{model_name}}? This can reduce inference cost and latency. You may notice minor output quality differences.

[ ] I understand this may change output quality and evaluation metrics.

Cancel · Apply quantization`

ben: Add translation keys: `quant.modal.title`, `quant.modal.body.mild`, `quant.modal.checkbox`, `quant.modal.apply`. Also QA tests to ensure CTA disabled when required.

mia: Thanks  I'll update Figma and add the accessibility checklist to the PR.
